title: Sun Ling’s struggle
simplified_paragraphs: 孙玲出生在湖南的国家级贫困县，家庭经济状态一直很困难。19岁时只有高中学历的她来到深圳，进入了一家电池厂，开始在流水线上工作。那时她每天工作12个小时，月薪只有2300元。
来到深圳后的第十个月，她省吃俭用，报了一个电脑培训班，学习一些基本的编程内容。后来孙玲说，那段日子很充实，她坚信学习可以改变现状。学完电脑课程以后，她找到了一份新的工作，工资更高，也更轻松一些。新工作开始后不久，她又报了一个英语培训班，一边工作，一边努力学习英语。之后，孙玲先后取得了计算机专业的大专文凭和专升本文凭。这时，她26岁，月薪过万了。
除了工作和学习，孙玲还积极发展自己的爱好。她学英语、玩飞盘、当博主，去过了更多的地方，也认识了更多的人。这些有趣的人让她有了去国外看看的念头。
2017年，孙玲看到一所美国学校的计算机硕士招生广告，而且学校会提供实习机会。虽然这不是特别好的学校，但是对于孙玲来说，这是一个机会，她很想抓住。七个月后，孙玲考过了雅思，拿到了去美国的学生签证。
孙玲来到美国，开始了她的学习。第一学期结束后，她开始找实习。两个月中，孙玲参加了60场面试，最后终于拿到了Google外包公司的工作机会。之后孙玲成为eBay员工，现在又被高盛录用。这一年，她30岁，年薪百万。
孙玲的这十年就像一个奇迹。学习能力很强的她凭借自己的努力，抓住每一个机会学习和进步，勇敢又能干。从普通厂妹到高薪程序员，这就是孙玲的奋斗之路。

2017年，孫玲看到一所美國學校的計算機碩士招生廣告，而且學校會提供實習機會。雖然這不是特別好的學校，但是對於孫玲來說，這是一個機會，她很想抓住。七個月後，孫玲考過了雅思，拿到了去美國的學生簽證。
孫玲來到美國，開始了她的學習。第一學期結束後，她開始找實習。兩個月中，孫玲參加了60場面試，最後終於拿到了Google外包公司的工作機會。之後孫玲成為eBay員工，現在又被高盛錄用。這一年，她30歲，年薪百萬。
孫玲的這十年就像一個奇蹟。學習能力很強的她憑借自己的努力，抓住每一個機會學習和進步，勇敢又能幹。從普通廠妹到高薪程序員，這就是孫玲的奮鬥之路。
pinyin_paragraphs: Sūn Líng chū shēng zài Hú Nán de guó jiā jí pín kùn xiàn， jiā tíng jīng jì zhuàng tài yī zhí hěn kùn nan。19 suì shí zhǐ yǒu gāo zhōng xué lì de tā lái dào Shēn zhèn， jìn rù le yī jiā diàn chí chǎng， kāi shǐ zài liú shuǐ xiàn shàng gōng zuò。 nà shí tā měi tiān gōng zuò 12 gè xiǎo shí， yuè xīn zhǐ yǒu 2300 yuán。

lái dào Shēn zhèn hòu de dì shí gè yuè， tā shěng chī jiǎn yòng， bào le yī gè diàn nǎo péi xùn bān， xué xí yī xiē jī běn de biān chéng nèi róng。 hòu lái Sūn Líng shuō， nà duàn rì zi hěn chōng shí， tā jiān xìn xué xí kě yǐ gǎi biàn xiàn zhuàng。 xué wán diàn nǎo kè chéng yǐ hòu， tā zhǎo dào le yī fèn xīn de gōng zuò， gōng zī gèng gāo， yě gèng qīng sōng yī xiē。 xīn gōng zuò kāi shǐ hòu bù jiǔ， tā yòu bào le yī gè Yīng yǔ péi xùn bān， yī biān gōng zuò， yī biān nǔ lì xué xí Yīng yǔ。 zhī hòu， Sūn Líng xiān hòu qǔ dé le jì suàn jī zhuān yè de dà zhuān wén píng hé zhuān shēng běn wén píng。 zhè shí， tā 26 suì， yuè xīn guò wàn le。

chú le gōng zuò hé xué xí， Sūn Líng hái jī jí fā zhǎn zì jǐ de ài hào。 tā xué Yīng yǔ、 wán fēi pán、 dāng bó zhǔ， qù guo le gèng duō de dì fang， yě rèn shi le gèng duō de rén。 zhè xiē yǒu qù de rén ràng tā yǒu le qù guó wài kàn kan de niàn tou。

2017 nián， Sūn Líng kàn dào yī suǒ Měi guó xué xiào de jì suàn jī shuò shì zhāo shēng guǎng gào， ér qiě xué xiào huì tí gōng shí xí jī huì。 suī rán zhè bù shì tè bié hǎo de xué xiào， dàn shì duì yú Sūn Líng lái shuō， zhè shì yī gè jī huì， tā hěn xiǎng zhuā zhù。 qī gè yuè hòu， Sūn Líng kǎo guò le Yǎ sī， ná dào le qù Měi guó de xué shēng qiān zhèng。

Sūn Líng lái dào Měi guó， kāi shǐ le tā de xué xí。 dì yī xué qī jié shù hòu， tā kāi shǐ zhǎo shí xí。 liǎng gè yuè zhōng， Sūn Líng cān jiā le 60 chǎng miàn shì， zuì hòu zhōng yú ná dào le Google wài bāo gōng sī de gōng zuò jī huì。 zhī hòu Sūn Líng chéng wéi eBay yuán gōng， xiàn zài yòu bèi Gāo shèng lù yòng。 zhè yī nián， tā 30 suì， nián xīn bǎi wàn。

Sūn Líng de zhè shí nián jiù xiàng yī gè qí jì。 xué xí néng lì hěn qiáng de tā píng jiè zì jǐ de nǔ lì， zhuā zhù měi yī gè jī huì xué xí hé jìn bù， yǒng gǎn yòu néng gàn。 cóng pǔ tōng chǎng mèi dào gāo xīn chéng xù yuán， zhè jiù shì Sūn Líng de fèn dòu zhī lù。
english_paragraphs: Sun Ling was born in a county in Hunan officially classified as one of the country’s poorest. Her family had always struggled financially. At nineteen, with only a high school education, she moved to Shenzhen and took a job at a battery factory. She worked on an assembly line for twelve hours a day and earned just 2,300 yuan a month.

Ten months after arriving in Shenzhen, she saved her money and signed up for a computer training class to learn some basic programming content. Later, Sun Ling said that those days were very fulfilling and she firmly believed that learning could change the status quo. After finishing the computer course, she found a new job with a higher salary and easier work. Shortly after starting her new job, she signed up for an English training class and worked hard while learning English. After that, Sun Ling obtained a college diploma and a college-to-undergraduate diploma in computer science. At this time, she was 26 years old and had a monthly salary of over 10,000 yuan.

In addition to work and study, Sun Ling also actively develops her own hobbies. She learned English, played Frisbee, became a blogger, traveled to more places, and met more people. These interesting people gave her the idea to visit foreign countries.

In 2017, Sun Ling saw an advertisement for a master's degree in computer science from an American school, and the school would provide internship opportunities. Although this is not a particularly good school, for Sun Ling, this is an opportunity that she wants to seize. Seven months later, Sun Ling passed the IELTS test and obtained a student visa to the United States.

Sun Ling came to the United States and began her studies. After her first semester, she started looking for an internship. In two months, Sun Ling participated in 60 interviews and finally got a job opportunity from Google outsourcing company. Sun Ling later became an eBay employee and is now employed by Goldman Sachs. This year, she is 30 years old and has an annual salary of one million.

Sun Ling's ten years have been like a miracle. She has a strong learning ability and relies on her own efforts to seize every opportunity to learn and progress. She is brave and capable. From an ordinary factory girl to a high-paid programmer, this is Sun Ling's journey of struggle.
